converter.fields: Known modern fields copied to intermediate+134 at corresponding raw offsets, with two opaque holes preserved from incoming intermediate seed. FlagsWORD uses OR with preexisting intermediate flags, not assignment.
converter.strings: 5 leading fixed UTF16 fields,20 messages512WCHAR and HeroName32WCHAR use bounded wide strncpy/padding and force finalWORD0. SoundCategory/TerrainPath32char use bounded strncpy and force finalbyte0.
converter.physical_policy: Raw strings, trailing bytes and opaque ranges remain authoritative for lossless serialization. Native converter normalization is separate.

writer.condition: Unassigned-gap result is for valid model pointers and strings that stay within field capacities, with explicit UI/date/file provider fixtures. Not a universal alias or real GUI save proof.
writer.order: Construct12-byte DC header,36-byte DD header,8-byte DF envelope plus25683 payload,8-byte DE envelope, N*72 reference bytes and K*4 available-creature bytes. Whole size=0x6493+72*N+4*K; DE dataBytes=72*N+4*K.
writer.player_count: Payload6404 stores low8(model A68 totalPlayers -2). Controlled total2/4 fixtures produce0/2.
writer.automatic_flag04: Before serializing,48EA60 clears modelFlagsDC bit04. For any player model whose unsigned byte1C>=3 and byte40==0, sets that bit again. Other flags retained. Semantic labels of those player fields and gameplay meaning of flag04 are not established by this phase.
writer.available_creatures: 48C030 returns AL from model F8 byte array. Writer stores only AL into stack DWORD at entrySP-64F0 then writes4 bytes. Upper24 bits retain scratch seed in controlled full writer runs. Keep all4 physical bytes in a lossless editor.
writer.output_policy: Do not reproduce uninitialized bytes as canonical data. Keep original opaque fields/upper creature bytes on save; for new files choose explicit initialization as our own format policy, not a claim that native always writes zero.

editor_strings.wide_helper: 48CF90 widens each signed source byte to WORD:80->FF80,FF->FFFF. Uses CString stored length, copying all source bytes; count only pads when shorter and is NOT a truncation bound.
editor_strings.ascii_helper: 4AB3B0 similarly copies all CString length then pads to count. Neither helper implements a general bounded copy.
editor_strings.overlong_case: With synthetic Information CString1027 bytes (1026 I bytes plus80), actual writer writes FF80 into raw1184, the firstWORD of the520-byte gap. Later trigger/TPS assignments repair the preceding two overwrittenWORDs. This is an isolated memory-only malformed-model fixture, not evidence the real GUI accepts that text length.
editor_strings.warning: Normal bounded-field scratch statement cannot be generalized to oversized CString models. This codec accepts direct UTF16 file storage; native signed-byte conversion is an optional diagnostic projection.
